summary.suggested: The Sedalia Democrat carried a St. Louis dispatch reporting that Tom Allen beat Mike McCoole in seven rounds on Chouteau Island, above St. Louis, before about 2,000 people, McCoole's seconds giving up the fight.

metadata.notes: page running head reads DAILY DEMOCRAT (Sedalia); full masthead not visible. Dispatch datelined St. Louis, Sept. 23

facts.fact: Allen defeated Mike McCoole in seven rounds on Chouteau Island, about 14 miles above St. Louis, when McCoole's second Tom Kelley threw up the handkerchief; about 2,000 watched
Before the last round Allen asked that McCoole be taken away rather than be disfigured
facts.quote: It is a sin to bring that man up. If you don't take him away I'll disfigure him for life; he is the gamest man I ever met.
